sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant, Puneet Nanda with a prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 293 of 2023, under Sections 420, 406, 504, 506, 120-B, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station- Naimandi, District- Muzaffar Nagar during pendency of trial.

3. The FIR has been lodged against the applicant with the allegations that the payment amounting to Rs. 30,85,020/- towards payment of amount as per the partnership deed according to which Rs. 9,375/- per acre has not been made and after selling the property he has absconded.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that it is admitted case that the applicant had taken the property in question on lease and as per the partnership agreement Rs. 9,375/- per acre per month was to be given to the informant which has been paid for the period from 15.2.2019.
Due to pandemic Covid-19, the amount as agreed as per the partnership deed could not be paid.
The counsel for the applicant further submits that three other FIRs have been lodged in the same Police Staion with nearly the same allegation as the present one.

The applicant is ready and willing to pay the rest of the amount which as per his calculation comes to nearly Rs.
32,00,000/-.
5. Counsel for the informant is however disputing the amount to be paid.
However he has no objection in case

the applicant is released on bail after deposition of the amount as admitted by him i.e. Rs. 32,00,000/- On the aforesaid learned counsel for the applicant submits that he is ready and willing to deposit Rs. 16,00,000/- within 15 days i.e. by 13.2.2024.

6. In view of above, the applicant is granted 15 days' time to deposit Rs.16,00,000/-
before the Court concerned, which shall be kept in interest bearing account of Nationalized Bank, receipt whereof will be issued in favour of the applicant.

7. Put up as fresh on 15.2.2024 along with Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55893 of 2023, Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55892 of 2023 and Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55887 of 2023.
8.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant states that he is ready and willing to deposit the rest of amount of Rs.16,00,000/- within six months, i.e. Rs.8,00,000/- within four months after release and next amount of Rs.8,00,000/- after two months thereafter, i.e. the entire amount of Rs.16,00,000/- on or before August, 2024.
The amount so deposited may be kept in the fixed deposit account bearing interest of a nationalized bank during the pendency of the trial court proceedings.

7. Learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant has no objection in case the applicant is released on bail subject to deposit of the remaining amount of Rs.16,00,000/-
before the court concerned within six months from today.

8. Considering the submission of learned counsel for the parties and the fact that the applicant already paid Rs.16 lakhs before the court concerned and applicant is ready and willing to deposit the remaining amount before the court concerned, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail subject to deposition of rest amount of Rs.16,00,000/- after being released, i.e. out of the aforesaid amount,
Rs.8,00,000/- shall be paid within four months and next rest amount of Rs.8,00,000/- shall be deposited within two months thereafter, i.e. the entire amount of Rs.16,00,000/- on or before August, 2024.
The amount so deposited may be kept in the fixed deposit account bearing interest of a nationalized bank during the pendency of the trial court proceedings.

9. Let the applicant involved in the aforesaid case crimes be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to the following conditions:-
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witness.

iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted and/or the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
vi. The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court.
vii. In the event, the applicant changes his residential address, the applicant shall inform the court concerned about new residential address in writing.

11. In the event, the applicant shall deposit the rest amount of Rs.16,00,000/- after being released,
i.e. out of the aforesaid amount, Rs.8,00,000/- shall be paid within four months and next rest amount of Rs.8,00,000/- shall be deposited within two months thereafter, i.e. the entire amount of Rs.16,00,000/- on or before August, 2024.

However, in case of default in deposit of the remaining amount before the court concerned as directed above, this order shall stand automatically vacated and the applicant shall be taken into custody, forthwith.
